name: The Blade Finishes the Sentence
jem_summary: With Magic Blade learned, successfully trigger the selected spell through an actual compatible weapon swing.

pages.title: The Blade Finishes the Sentence
pages.text: With Magic Blade learned, successfully trigger the selected spell through an actual compatible weapon swing.

pages.title: The Blade Finishes the Sentence
pages.text: Connect a weapon swing with an eligible magical result.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The skill respects cooldown and can reduce a spell below its valid level: failed attempts do not count. Hasty Casting and Rapid Chant separately change movement, preparation or channel behavior.
